attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Gallows Crew has a doctor held captive.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as a present item, with no clause marking it as already reported"},{"span":"The Empire has dispatched envoys to the Outlanders.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats the same news a second time as if it were a separate item, which pads the bulletin"},{"span":"merely another tedious formality","severity":"minor","reason":"'another' implies earlier envoy visits the briefing does not give; the guess framing only partly covers it"}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin restates the single new fact twice, with the first line copied nearly verbatim from the briefing, then pads with an old-news item about the doctor that is not marked as old.
